GLOBAL REEF COVERAGE vs. BIODIVERSITY CONTRIBUTION
====================================================

Ocean floor total:  ~361 million km²
Coral reef area:    ~284,300 km²   (0.079% of ocean floor)
                    ≈ size of Italy

                    BIODIVERSITY CONTRIBUTION
+-------------------------------------------------------+
|  Reef area fraction of ocean                          |
|  ████░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░  0.1%               |
|                                                       |
|  Fraction of marine species on reefs                  |
|  ████████████████████████████░░░░  25–35%             |
|                                                       |
|  ~830 coral species (hard corals)                     |
|  ~4,000 fish species associated with reefs            |
|  ~1 million species estimated total (most undescribed)|
+-------------------------------------------------------+

REEF TYPE DISTRIBUTION (by area estimate)
+------------------------------------------+
| Indo-Pacific                  ~91.9%     |
|   Southeast Asia (Coral Triangle) ~30%   |
|   Great Barrier Reef              ~14%   |
|   Pacific island reefs            ~25%   |
|   Indian Ocean reefs              ~23%   |
| Atlantic / Caribbean           ~7.3%     |
| Red Sea / Arabian Gulf         ~0.8%     |
+------------------------------------------+

FRINGING REEF          BARRIER REEF            ATOLL
                                            (oceanic)
 ~~~Sea~~~              ~~~Sea~~~           ~~~Sea~~~
+-------+             +--+ ~~~ +--+      +--+   +--+
| Reef  |             |R | Lag |R |      |R |   |R |
+-------+             +--+ oon +--+      +--+   +--+
| Shore |             |   Reef  |        |  Lagoon  |
+-------+             +---------+        +----------+

Directly adjacent   Separated from       Volcanic island
to coastline        shore by lagoon      subsided; ring
                    100m–10km wide       of reef remains

CROSS-SECTION: FRINGING/BARRIER REEF PROFILE
=============================================

  Shore/          Reef      Reef    Fore-Reef    Reef
  Lagoon          Flat      Crest   Slope        Wall/Base

  ~0.5m depth   0–1m      0–1m     2–20m        20–100m+
  calm, warm    surge      high     moderate     low light
  seagrass      exposed    energy   light        deep
                at low tide                      specialists

  ←  back reef  →←  reef flat/crest  →←    fore-reef    →

THREAT MATRIX
=============

+---------------------------+----------+----------+----------+
| Threat                    | Scale    | Speed    | Status   |
+---------------------------+----------+----------+----------+
| Ocean warming / bleaching | Global   | Decadal  | Acute ↑  |
| Ocean acidification       | Global   | Centennial| Chronic ↑|
| Overfishing               | Regional | Years    | Chronic  |
| Nutrient / sediment runoff| Local    | Years    | Chronic  |
| Crown-of-thorns outbreaks | Regional | Seasonal | Episodic |
| Physical damage           | Local    | Immediate| Chronic  |
| Disease                   | Regional | Months   | Emerging ↑|
| Sea level rise            | Global   | Centennial| Future   |
+---------------------------+----------+----------+----------+

Current status:
- ~50% of reef coral cover lost globally since 1950
- Great Barrier Reef: 50% decline 1995–2021
- Caribbean: 80% loss since 1970s
- Projections: 70–90% loss at +1.5°C; >99% at +2°C
